serviceIdentification.serviceDescription:
## Offering

Legora is an AI workspace for legal teams: legal research, document review, drafting, and legal and regulatory monitoring in one place. Counsel work in Legora or directly in Word or Outlook, across large volumes of documents, with every answer cited to the authority or document it came from. The proposed listing covers the Legora SaaS offering delivered through its commercial U.S. environment. The features and information types available for each federal use will be agreed with the agency.

## Listing status

Legora is preparing an Initial Implementation Marketplace listing request under FedRAMP 20x.

Last updated: 2026-11-05.

## Intended agency use

Use type: Direct Use.

Scope: Proposed scope for provider review.

Legora intends federal agency counsel to use its workspace directly, in a federal agency information system that will receive an Authorization to Operate. The intended use is the day-to-day legal work every agency carries: FOIA and other records requests, employment matters, contracting and procurement, and litigation and investigations. In each case counsel are working through large volumes of agency records, researching the statutes and regulations that apply to the agency, and preparing drafts for attorney review. An initial evaluation would use public or synthetic material. The agency would determine permissible data and authorize use.

## Secure configuration guidance

Applicable guidance and a public reference will be confirmed for the proposed offering before the listing request.

## Progress

Update cadence: At least quarterly.

Next review target: 2027-02-04.

### Prepare the Marketplace listing

Target: Before the listing request.

Progress: Public overview and JSON drafted for review.

Next action: Approve the listing facts, publish the public files and validate their live URLs.

### Request Initial Implementation status

Target: After public content approval and live validation.

Progress: Request materials prepared for review.

Next action: Submit the provider listing form and retain the acknowledgement.

### Document certification readiness

Target: Next quarterly progress update.

Progress: A working certification package is being developed.

Next action: Record progress on offering scope, security evidence and the certification application.

### Plan the next assessment

Target: Within two years of the initial Marketplace listing date.

Progress: Assessment scheduling remains a planning item.

Next action: Document a scheduled Class B, C or D assessment within the required period.

The Trust Center provides public security information and an access request process for available assurance documentation. Public FedRAMP listing information is maintained on this page and in its companion JSON.
trustCenter.accessRequestInstructions: Open the public Trust Center. For restricted documentation, select Request access and complete the access request. Contact fedramp-security@legora.com for help.
